ladder.label: BUY ZONE
ladder.why: New daily cycle, day 11: swing low in, price back above the 10-day average, daily momentum positive — and the weekly timeframe agrees.
ladder.next: The highest-odds window by cycle logic; invalidation = a close below the cycle low (142.0).
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum just crossed up; 3-day crossed up
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BULLISH — weekly momentum just crossed up; 3-day crossed up (investor cycle week 11 · daily cycle day 11).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): buy zone. Bigger picture (with-trend): bullish.
points: Bigger picture is bullish (with-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds
Macro-risk: aggregate macro risk elevated for a macro-sensitive name — caution on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Back above the 10-day average, and it's turning up

entry.text: Confirmed cycle low — the entry window is open now, with a clear exit if it closes back below 142.0.
entry.text_zh: 周期低点已确认——入场窗口现已开启，若收盘重新跌破 142.0 则明确离场。

cycle_plain.daily_line: Daily cycle: day 11 of a typical 36–42 trading days
cycle_plain.daily_phase: fresh — a new cycle just started
cycle_plain.daily_line_zh: 日线周期：第 11 天，典型周期为 36–42 个交易日
cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 11 of a typical 16–26 weeks
cycle_plain.weekly_phase: mid — the bigger up-leg is maturing
cycle_plain.weekly_line_zh: 周线（投资者）周期：第 11 周，典型周期为 16–26 周
cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its SECOND half ('right-translated') — strong cycles top late, a healthy-uptrend sign.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在后半段见顶（“右移”）——强周期见顶偏晚，属于健康上涨趋势的信号。

ladder.why_zh: 新的日线周期，第 11 天：摆动低点已现，价格重新站上 10 日均线，日线动量为正——且周线周期也一致确认。
ladder.next_zh: 按周期逻辑胜率最高的窗口；失效点 = 收盘跌破周期低点（142.0）。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看多 — 周线动量刚刚向上交叉；3 日线向上交叉（投资者周期第 11 周 · 日线周期第 11 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：买入区。大局（顺势）：看多。
points_zh: 大局为看多（对日线多头而言属顺势）
宏观：美国净流动性中性——对概率属无方向性影响
宏观风险：总体宏观风险偏高且标的对宏观敏感——对概率需谨慎
摆动低点已现（买方拒绝了该低点）
重新站上 10 日均线之上，且均线开始向上
ladder.liq_line: US net liquidity is neutral right now — no macro tilt either way on the odds.
ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。
ladder.macro_line: Macro-risk headwind: aggregate macro risk is elevated and this is a macro-sensitive (cyclical) name — buy setups here have historically taken deeper drawdowns, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. A risk/sizing caution, not a forecast.
ladder.macro_line_zh: 宏观风险逆风：总体宏观风险偏高，且该标的对宏观较敏感（周期性）——在此环境下买入形态历史上回撤更深，因此应要求更多确认并降低仓位。这是风险/仓位提示，并非预测。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ BUY ZONE signal triggered 4 trading days ago (~2026-06-08), switching from BOTTOMING. Signal strength: strong (score +84/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 买入区信号于 4 个交易日前触发（约 2026-06-08），自筑底中切换而来。 信号强度：强（评分 +84/100）。
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
